xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Assessment Order for the Assessment Year 2017-18 was issued to Prime Gourmet Private Limited (PGPL), the erstwhile subsidiary of the Company. In the said order, certain expenses were disallowed and certain items were considered as income under the Income Tax Act and demanded PGPL to pay tax and interest on the aforesaid amounts. Though the liability pertains to PGPL, the Company as a holding company during that period and as outlined in the Shareholders' Agreement, needs to absorb this liability. Therefore, the disputed amount is disclosed as contingent liability in the financial statements of the Company.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The appeal is currently pending before Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals).
